title: Red Hat Security Advisory: .NET 10.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: .NET 10.0 for Red Hat Enterprise Linux has multiple security vulnerabilities including information disclosure, elevation of privilege, and denial of service affecting ASP.NET Core and .NET components. These issues are addressed in an update to SDK version 10.0.115 and Runtime version 10.0.15. The update also includes bug fixes and enhancements. The vulnerabilities have been rated as important by Red Hat Product Security.
